notes: disable-model-invocation is set, so no prompt can route here: every case is a behaviour case and run-evals.py skips them until a fixture and a judge exist.

evals.name: one-question-per-unit-before-any-change
evals.expected_output: The plan is grouped into units (a phase, related phases, or a milestone). Two fresh readers run in one message. For every unit with a verified proposal, a brief is printed first — what the pass checked and applied, then each unit explained in plain words with the current plan and the recommendation — and then one AskUserQuestion question offers Simplify, Delete or Keep as is, recommended first, in plain short sentences, each description on one line. Nothing in todo.md or tech-design.md changes before the final Apply.

evals.name: unjustified-unbuilt-phase-is-deleted-to-deferred
evals.expected_output: Phase 9 builds an admin CSV export no story asks for. The user picks Delete. The phase and its contracts are removed, edges that pointed at it are rewired, unbuilt phases are renumbered, and a plain bullet naming it and the reason lands in ## Deferred above the first milestone.

evals.name: safeguard-without-trigger-is-proposed-for-simplify
evals.expected_output: Phase 5 adds a circuit breaker and retries around an internal module call. No trigger holds, so Simplify is recommended and the description says the user sees a clear error instead. A rate limit on the public signup endpoint in the same plan is kept, with its trigger shown in the final review.

evals.name: story-backed-unit-gets-no-delete-option
evals.expected_output: A unit that traces to a user story is offered Simplify and Keep only, never Delete. Where the spec itself asks for something that looks over-built, it is recorded as a question in Open questions, not cut.

evals.name: built-phase-gets-a-new-phase-not-an-edit
evals.expected_output: Phases 1-6 are built. For built Phase 4 the user picks Simplify. Phase 4 keeps its number, title and ticks. A new behaviour-preserving phase is added at the end of the plan, except that an unbuilt phase building on that code makes it go just before that phase, which then depends on it.

evals.name: final-review-then-apply
evals.expected_output: After all units are answered, the skill shows deleted, rewritten, added, kept, dismissed, questions and the renumbering map, runs check_todo.py --spec --against on the draft, then asks Apply / Change an answer / Cancel with AskUserQuestion. Only Apply writes both files; Cancel writes nothing and records mode declined.

evals.name: no-agent-tool-blocks-rather-than-reviewing-inline
evals.expected_output: In a context with no Agent tool the skill stops with blocked: no-agent, writes nothing, records mode blocked, and does not review the plan itself in the same context.

evals.name: embedded-in-spec-design-before-codex
evals.expected_output: After pass 3 and before the Codex challenge, spec-design follows plan-simplify over its draft. Clear units (no story behind them, a safeguard with no trigger) are simplified or deleted without a question; only unclear units are asked with AskUserQuestion. Every change appears with its reason at spec-design's single gate, where the user can bring any back. A later Codex finding that would restore a removed unit is dismissed, unless the removal took a story.
